subject: Patrick Clerkin City Council Candidate Profile
overview: City Council candidate Patrick Clerkin presents his platform, emphasizing fiscal stability, neighborhood-focused development, and improved municipal communication.

items.title: Candidate Background and Governance Philosophy
items.summary: Patrick Clerkin introduces himself as a mechanical engineer and candidate for City Council, pledging to prioritize local issues over national politics and provide independent governance.

items.title: Top Campaign Priorities
items.summary: The candidate identifies his three primary concerns as budget underfunding, development that fails to account for neighborhood impacts, and a lack of clear communication regarding city processes.

items.title: Infrastructure and Public Facilities
items.summary: Clerkin addresses the need for road and sidewalk repairs, a new fire station headquarters, and a sustainable plan for the high school before concluding with a call for support.
